verdict.rationale: The DGFiP professional portal itself advertises "Payer en ligne" and a professional-space login, and it addresses accessing and paying CFE notices online. That shows the core payment transaction can be done online per the service's own pages, and it also lists online correction of income declarations. missing for 10: explicit evidence of online filing of professional declarations (e.g., VAT, corporate tax), step-by-step documentation of the payment flow beyond link labels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Le service de correction des déclarations de revenus en ligne est ouvert du 29 juillet au 30 novembre 2026 inclus.
